\chapter{Three Known Lines, One Small Form}
\label{ch:pa-form-three-preparation}
\hlchaptermodality{22}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can bring the known language, residence, and work fields together with their closed banks still visible.}

The learner assembles three supported lines only after label placement, cue selection, and a two-line bridge have each received a bounded pass; this supported work is not independent-writing evidence.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[three known form labels]{Put three known labels on one small form}

\label{lesson:PA-W06-three-field-labels}



\begin{quote}
Read the three labels once: \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}}, \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}}, \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}}. Each label is old; only seeing all three together is new.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one placement pass}
Point from the first blank line to the third. Place \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}} first, \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}} second, and \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}} third. Do not choose or write any value.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the labels. Say which known label belongs on the middle line, then reveal and check only its placement.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after the labels are in place. Values arrive in the next lesson.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[three remembered bank cues]{Select three values before writing}

\label{lesson:PA-W06-three-field-cues}



\begin{quote}
Read each closed practice bank once:

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}: A — \textbf{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}} · B — \textbf{\pa{ਹਿੰਦੀ}}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}: A — \textbf{\pa{ਪਿੰਡ}} · B — \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਕੰਮ}: A — \textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}} · B — \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}}
\end{quote}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one cue per field}
For the cue row \textbf{A · B · A}, point to the selected language, residence, and work values in that order. Do not copy them.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover all three banks and name the selections once. Reveal and check only selection; spelling and form placement wait.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Selection is now ready for a two-line writing bridge.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[two supported form lines]{Join two supported lines first}

\label{lesson:PA-W06-two-field-supported}



\begin{quote}
Keep the language and residence banks visible. Read the cue pair \textbf{A · B} and point to \textbf{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — two models remain visible}
Complete only these two lines:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
B — \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

Copy the selected values while their banks remain visible. This is supported entry, not independent writing evidence.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Check the first line, then the second. Stop before adding a work line.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The third line joins only after two lines feel small.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[three supported form lines]{Add the third supported line}

\label{lesson:PA-W06-three-field-supported}



\begin{quote}
Keep all three old banks visible. Select the cue row \textbf{A · B · A} without writing.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — all models remain visible}
Complete one language line, one residence line, and one work line. Copy from the visible banks. This is supported entry, not independent writing evidence.

\subsection*{Your turn — one pass at a time}
Check selection on all three lines. Then check spelling. Then check spacing and placement. Do not mix the passes.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Close the banks before beginning the separate repair lessons.
\end{tcolorbox}
